parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment explicitly asks the authors to "clearly define what verification means in this context." This is a direct action. Moreover, the request is concrete: the authors know exactly what needs to be done—namely, provide a clear definition of "verification" in the context of the consistency condition in the second contribution bullet—and how to apply it by revising that specific claim. The comment also grounds the request by pointing out precisely why the current claim is problematic (it is unclear how r could be guaranteed or computed ahead of time or after observing gradients), which makes the needed modification apparent. Therefore, the comment contains an explicit action with concrete details on how to implement it.

change_log.reason: Misapplication of the rubric: demanding the reviewer provide the actual definition content goes beyond what 'concrete' requires.
